_about: Ethanol (1) + Isobutanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Resa, J. M.[Jose M.], Gonzalez, C.[Cristina], Goenaga, J. source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0027. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.20 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
